deviations: V-2: corpus allowed_paths (engine/**, core/**, platform/**, models/**) do not exist literally at the HeardRight repo top level; actual crates live under tauri-app-next/ and were mapped per path_mapping above.

heardright_capture is an unconditional path dependency of the upstream engine crate (path = "../heardright_capture"). It is vendored at engine/heardright_capture/ to keep the lane_b vendor glob; the upstream relative path will need a manifest topology adjustment by the serial merge task before a local cargo build.

The upstream engine's Windows-only parakeet-rs path dependency (../parakeet-rs-bench/vendor/parakeet-rs) is not vendored; see excluded_with_reason. CutRight resolves Parakeet inference from signed runtime packs.

models/**: no model bytes exist inside the selected crates except engine/src/whisper_mel_128.bin (mel filterbank, hash-bound in the graph); model weights are never vendored and are tracked by CR-V2-B1-013's asset ledger.
Receipt lives at imports/v2/receipts/heardright-source.json per the dispatch task manifest rather than the interface-freeze default <destination>/.import-receipts/ location.
